item.title: Works to upgrade Meath Street to begin on Monday
item.description: Work is due to get underway this month on a major public realm upgrade of Meath Street in Dublin’s Liberties, aimed at revitalising one of the area’s most historic and well-known streets. Dublin City Council has appointed Cairn Construction as the main contractor for the project, which will deliver new paving, improved pedestrian facilities, changes to the road layout, and the introduction of street trees and landscaping along the length of the street. item.title: Met Éireann Lifts Orange Rain Warning In Dublin And Wicklow
item.description: After nearly two weeks of relentless rain and the aftermath of Storm Chandra, conditions across the east of the country are finally beginning to ease, though authorities are warning that flooding risks have not yet passed in Dublin, Wicklow, and Meath. According to Met Éireann, rainfall has started to die down following a very wet night, with the heaviest rain in the east and north-east gradually easing through the morning. item.title: The Black Keys Announce New Album, 'Peaches' And Share New Single
item.description: The Black Keys have announced the release of their new album, Peaches, which they have previewed with a new single. item.title: How Brian May Connected With Guns N'Roses
item.description: It turns out that Guns N'Roses' track 'Atlas' has deep rooted connection to Queen guitarist Brian May. The song was one of two singles released by the band in December last year, with the other one titled, 'Nothin'. item.title: Wicklow Man Finally Joins An Garda Síochána After Nearly 20-Year Journey
item.description: A 38-year-old man from Blessington, Co. Wicklow, who has spent nearly two decades trying to join An Garda Síochána, is among 167 new recruits to graduate from the Garda College in Templemore today. Conor Finan’s journey to becoming a garda was far from straightforward.
